title: Buy what can go with you
subtitle: For the one who wants gain that survives loss
description: These readings turn trade language toward the soul, teaching the heart to invest in praise, truth, and Naam rather than what cannot travel.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Real wealth is the merchandise that goes with the soul when false profit falls away.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Before another task decorates the self, choose one act that deepens what can endure.

evidence.coreClaim: This path measures wealth by what remains with the soul.
evidence.turn: Gain becomes truthful when Naam matters more than possession.
evidence.practicalImplication: Spend time, attention, or money today on what can travel beyond display.
